passages.note: Lackey voted No on AB 2571, a bill regulating firearm advertising to minors, not firearm ownership, carry, or background checks.

passages.provision_quote: A firearm industry member shall not advertise, market, or arrange for placement of an advertising or marketing communication concerning any firearm-related product in a manner that is designed, intended, or reasonably appears to be attractive to minors.
passages.note: The operative clause restricts advertising/marketing firearms to minors; it does not address ownership, assault weapons, background checks, or carry rules.

rows.reasoning: AB 2571 (2021-2022) restricts firearm advertising and marketing directed at minors; its operative clauses do not ban any firearm type, impose background checks, or address carrying/permits, so Lackey's recorded No vote is adjacent to the gun-policy ladder's question and off-axis to the dimension the rungs order. No passage establishes a chair.
